providers.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
providers.description: The largest and most mature cloud platform, offering a vast array of services and global reach.
providers.strength: Broadest service portfolio, strong enterprise adoption, global infrastructure.
providers.weakness: Complex pricing, can be overwhelming for beginners.

providers.name: Microsoft Azure
providers.description: Integrated with Microsoft ecosystem, strong in hybrid cloud and enterprise solutions.
providers.strength: Best for Microsoft shops, hybrid cloud, and compliance.

providers.name: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
providers.description: Excels in data analytics, machine learning, and open-source technologies.
providers.strength: Best for big data, AI, and Kubernetes.
providers.weakness: Smaller enterprise footprint, fewer regions than AWS/Azure.

providers.name: Oracle Cloud
providers.description: Focused on database, ERP, and enterprise workloads with competitive pricing.
providers.strength: Best for Oracle workloads, database migration, and cost efficiency.

providers.name: Alibaba Cloud
providers.description: Leading cloud provider in Asia, strong in e-commerce and Chinese market.
providers.strength: Best for Asia-Pacific, e-commerce, and scalability.
